summary: Apply WEAI, Pro-WEAI and gender analysis to agricultural projects. Develop action plans and monitoring outputs. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Gender analysis in agricultural development helps project managers, advisers and monitoring specialists examine roles, resource access and decisions. The training covers reviewing project assumptions, interpreting sex-disaggregated evidence with WEAI and Pro-WEAI, mapping access to resources, and linking gender objectives and indicators to activities, budgets and monitoring.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or inform gender-related decisions in agricultural and rural development programmes, research and monitoring.
modules: FAO Policy and Agrifood Gender Relations
GALS for Household and Community Decisions
Gender Action Plans and Project Budgets
prerequisites: Working familiarity with agricultural or rural development programme design, implementation, research or monitoring is expected. No coding is required.
